summary: Aptiv PLC filed an 8-K noting the completion of the spin-off of its Electrical Distribution Systems business. The separation was effected as a tax-free distribution to Aptiv shareholders. No specific terms (exchange ratio, cash in lieu, trading date) are given in this excerpt. The board previously approved the transaction; no advisor is named. The spin-off creates a standalone publicly traded entity. What to watch: first-day trading of the new entity and any subsequent index inclusion, as well as potential shareholder base shifts.
